programmes.name_en: Qatar Business Incubation Center (QBIC) LeanStartup programme
programmes.funder: Qatar Business Incubation Center (QBIC), a QDB initiative
programmes.amount_note: Incubation with workspace and mentoring, plus access to QDB seed financing of up to around QAR 200,000 for graduates of the LeanStartup track. Terms vary by cohort.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based; QBIC announces LeanStartup intakes on qbic.qa, historically two per year.
programmes.reopen_note: QBIC has run LeanStartup and Company Builder cohorts roughly twice a year; check qbic.qa for the current window.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online during an open cohort.
Graduation and access to QDB financing.

documents_required.doc: Qatari ID or residency for at least one founder in most tracks

eligibility.other_note: Focus on Qatar-based founders; the business must be or become Qatari-registered.

programmes.name_local: بنك قطر للتنمية - التمويل المباشر وبرنامج الضمين
programmes.name_en: QDB Direct Financing and Al Dhameen guarantee
programmes.amount_note: QDB Credit Guarantee Program typically guarantees up to 50% of the financed amount, up to 70% for low-ticket financing. It is not a direct financing scheme.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through QDB or, for Al Dhameen, through a partner bank.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the financing application with a feasibility study.

eligibility.other_note: Qatar-based private sector companies (micro, small, medium or large) with a valid commercial licence, except joint stock and public holding companies.

programmes.source_snippet: Typically, up to 50% of the financed amount, and up to 70% for low-ticket financing. ... The Credit Guarantee Program is not a direct financing scheme.

programmes.amount_note: START track up to USD 1.1M; GROW track up to USD 5.5M.
programmes.deadline_note: QDB runs the programme through periodic themed calls (for example sports tech, fintech, food security) announced on qdb.qa and startupqatar.qa.
programmes.reopen_note: Startup Qatar has run repeated themed cohorts since 2023; each new vertical call is announced by QDB with its own window.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor QDB / Startup Qatar for the open vertical call.
Submit the application with a Qatar expansion plan.
Investment agreement conditional on establishing a Qatari entity.

eligibility.other_note: Tech startups focused on high growth. START: validated concept, market readiness, experienced team. GROW: at least 3 years of established operations with positive growth outlook and financial stability.

programmes.source_snippet: START: Up to USD $1.1M. GROW: Up to USD $5.5M. Apply by filling out the online application form.

programmes.name_en: QRDI Council national research and innovation calls
programmes.funder: Qatar Research, Development and Innovation (QRDI) Council
programmes.amount_note: Themed calls run with partner ministries and corporates. Recent cycles awarded QAR 150,000 to QAR 300,000 for short six-to-twelve-month programmes and QAR 500,000 to QAR 800,000 per year for multi-year programmes (for example AI for Qatar, SEHATech, Path Towards Precision Medicine).
programmes.deadline_note: The most recent published cycle had submission deadlines of 18 February 2026 and 11 March 2026 across roughly a dozen themed programmes.
programmes.reopen_note: QRDI runs numbered cycles per programme (for example 'Path Towards Precision Medicine - 9th Cycle'), so most themes recur annually with deadlines in February and March. New cycles are published on the InnoLight portal at https://innolight.qrdi.org.qa.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the QRDI InnoLight portal.
Select the open themed programme matching your research area.
Submit the proposal by the cycle deadline.

documents_required.doc: Qatari host institution or partner details

eligibility.other_note: Most calls require a Qatar-based host institution or corporate partner; startups typically participate as part of a consortium.

programmes.source_snippet: Each award is up to QAR 500,000 per year for a duration of up to two years - Submission Deadline: 11 March 2026

programmes.amount_note: Up to 70% of exhibition space cost plus shell scheme, with flights and accommodation covered, for stands of 9-12 sqm; capped at QAR 200,000 per SME per year. Applications must be submitted at least 2-3 months before the exhibition.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit the application form with a quotation or contract at least 2-3 months before the exhibition.

eligibility.other_note: SMEs registered with Qatar Exports exhibiting at international fairs not on the Qatar Exports calendar. Apply with a price quotation or contract for the participation costs through the Qatar Exports portal.

programmes.source_snippet: The annual support cap is QAR 200,000 per SME.

programmes.amount_note: QDB covers up to 70% of the cost of an expert export study (market selection and go-to-market roadmap), capped at QAR 62,000.

eligibility.other_note: Qatar-based company operating in a QDB-mandated sector. Register at Qatar Exports and complete the application form.

programmes.source_snippet: QDB covers up to 70% or up to QAR 62,000 of the service cost, whichever is lower.

programmes.amount_note: Covers up to 50% of certification costs, not exceeding QAR 21,000 per certificate, with a cap of QAR 200,000 per commercial registration.

eligibility.other_note: Qatari SMEs and startups with at least 51% Qatari ownership in QDB-mandated sectors; valid commercial registration and industrial licence; in operation for over six months; product with export potential.

programmes.source_snippet: For each product certification, program would cover up to 50% of the total costs, but not exceeding QAR 21,000/- per certificate.

programmes.amount_note: Sharia-compliant direct financing of up to 70% of the contract value, maximum QAR 100 million, tenor up to 10 years, for Qatari companies expanding operations abroad.

eligibility.other_note: Majority Qatari-owned (min. 51%) business with annual operating revenue of at least QAR 10 million, at least 3 years of operating history and positive operating profit for the last 2 years; all sectors except hydrocarbon exports.

programmes.source_snippet: Financing up to 70% of the contract value, with a maximum of QAR 100 million.

programmes.amount_note: Raw-material financing against a confirmed purchase or supply order: up to 80% of contract value, profit 3-5% per annum, duration up to one year, renewable or as agreed.

eligibility.other_note: Qatar-based exporters with a confirmed order; apply through the QDB export financing form. Sharia-compliant.

programmes.source_snippet: Value: Up to 80% of contract value

programmes.amount_note: Early access to funds against international trade invoices: discount of up to 90% of invoice or letter of credit value, profit 3-5% per annum, one year renewable or as agreed. Sharia-compliant.

eligibility.other_note: Qatar-based exporters with international trade invoices or letters of credit.

programmes.source_snippet: Discount: Up to 90% of invoices / letters of credit value
